contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ M ANTONINVS [AVG GERM SARM TRPXXX PP ; R/ [IMP VIII COS III CLEMENTIA AVG]

Copper alloy Coin. Sestertius of Marcus Aurelius (139-180), mint of Rome issue of 175-176 as kindly identified by the finder; RIC volume 3 no. 1158. Obverse description: Head laureate right. Obverse inscription: M ANTONINVS [AVG GERM SARM TRPXXX PP. Reverse description: Clementia standing left holding patera in outstretched right hand and upright sceptre in left. S C in field. Reverse inscription: [IMP VIII COS III CLEMENTIA AVG]. Diameter: 32.0mm, Weight: 19.24gms, die axis: 6
